name: wide
description: Wide — a security-first IDE for the web stack. Native C++ (Win32 + WebView2) host on Windows, lightweight Chromium host on Linux, React renderer, Node backend sidecar.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:backend && npm run build:host
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:backend
scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File native-host/package.ps1
scripts.package:arch: npm run package:linux -- --dir-only && cd installer && makepkg -f && cp -f wide-ide-*.pkg.tar.zst ../dist/
scripts.package:all: npm run package:linux && npm run package:deb && npm run package:rpm && npm run package:arch && npm run package:appimage
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
